title: A Portrait for the Witness
author: Vesper Thornbury
blurb: Juniper Hartwell, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the trial begins.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
